column1: # (Qt 6.12.0); do not edit. Each row is Qt.tint(base, Qt.alpha(tint, factor)) run by Qt's
# QML engine: `result` the 8-bit red(), green(), blue() and alpha() the result reports, `stored`
# the 16-bit channels it holds, each over 65535 as a float. `tint`'s own alpha is replaced by
# Qt.alpha (written ff). Breeze's switch inputs (the Button set's text tinted by its background,
# BreezeLight.colors and BreezeDark.colors) at 0.9; on Breeze Light's pair and on 202,173,23 /
# (the tint's 8-bit alpha passing 0 to 1 and 254 to 255), 0, 1, -0.25 and 1.25; Breeze's pairs
# on bases of alpha 0 and 128; then, of 20000 seeded random opaque pairs (seed 20261123)
# at the switch's 0.9, up to 40 on which a naive port (the formula in f64 on the
# 8-bit channels, rounded once to 16 bits) gives another colour than Qt (8275 did) and
# 24 more; the same of 20000 pairs at random factors in [0, 1) (4425 did);
# then 24 random bases of random alpha at random factors.
